_about: Link database for SoC spec tables. CPU cores and Mali/Adreno GPUs are NOT listed here: they are read from the generations files (cpus.yaml / gpus.yaml) of the pages in cpu_sources and gpu_sources, the same files that render those pages' tables. The cpu/gpu/npu sections below only hold extra names those files lack. A spec name matches the longest key or alias it starts with, so "Mali-G610 MP4" resolves to "Mali-G610". Used by layouts/partials/soc/linkdb.html in the SBCwiki repo.
